Evidence of concurrent bacterial infection was found in specimens from 22 (29%) of the 77 patients
This report summarizes the demographic and clinical findings from these cases and the laboratory evaluation

methods_quotes.q: Of the 77 cases evaluated, 56 (72%) had at least some clinical information available
All bacteria were evaluated by a broad-range PCR assay that targets a segment of the 16S ribosomal DNA gene
